title.zh: 卷十五 本紀第十五: 聖宗六
title.raw: 卷十五 本紀第十五: 聖宗六 Volume 15 Annals 15: Shengzong 6

sentences.zh: 聖宗六

translations.literal: Shengzong, Part Six
translations.idiomatic: Shengzong, Part Six

sentences.zh: 二十八年春正月辛亥朔，不受賀。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on xinhai new moon, did not accept congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year of Tonghe, on the xinhai new moon of the first spring month the court declined congratulatory rites.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，如乾陵。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, went to Qian Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Emperor went to Qian Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，奉安大行皇太后梓宮於乾州菆塗殿。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, enshrined the late Empress Dowager's coffin at the Temporary Enclosure Hall in Qian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the late Empress Dowager's coffin was enshrined at the Temporary Enclosure Hall in Qian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，宋遣王隨、王儒等來吊祭。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingxu day, Song dispatched Wang Sui, Wang Ru and others to come mourn and sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day of the second month Song sent Wang Sui, Wang Ru, and others to offer mourning sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 己亥，高麗遣魏守愚等來祭。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Goryeo dispatched Wei Shouyu and others to come sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Goryeo sent Wei Shouyu and others to present offerings.

sentences.zh: 是月，遣左龍虎衛上將軍蕭合卓饋大行皇太后遺物於宋，仍遣臨海軍節度使蕭虛列、左領軍衛上將軍張崇濟謝宋吊祭。

translations.literal: That month, dispatched Left Dragon-Tiger Guard senior general Xiao Hezhuo to present the late Empress Dowager's keepsakes to Song, also dispatched Linhai Army military commissioner Xiao Xulie, Left Leading Army Guard senior general Zhang Chongji to thank Song for mourning and sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: That month Left Dragon-Tiger Guard senior general Xiao Hezhuo was sent with the late Empress Dowager's belongings to Song, while Linhai Army military commissioner Xiao Xulie and Left Leading Army Guard senior general Zhang Chongji were dispatched to thank Song for its mourning envoys.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯，上大行皇太后謚為聖神宣獻皇后。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guimao day, conferred posthumous title on the late Empress Dowager as Empress Shenshen Xuanxian.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day of the third month the late Empress Dowager was given the posthumous title Empress Shenshen Xuanxian.

sentences.zh: 是月，宋、高麗遣使來會葬。

translations.literal: That month, Song and Goryeo dispatched envoys to come attend burial.
translations.idiomatic: That month Song and Goryeo sent envoys to attend the burial.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，葬太后於乾陵。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on jiazi day, buried the Empress Dowager at Qian Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day of the fourth summer month the Empress Dowager was buried at Qian Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 賜大丞相耶律德昌名曰隆運。

translations.literal: Granted Grand Chancellor Yelü Dechang the name Longyun.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Chancellor Yelü Dechang was granted the name Longyun.

sentences.zh: 庚午，賜宅及陪葬地。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, granted residence and burial land.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day he was granted a residence and land for burial accompaniment.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯朔，如中京。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jimao new moon, went to Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao new moon of the fifth month the court went to the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，清暑七金山。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, summer coolness at Qijin Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the court took the summer retreat at Qijin Mountain.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，西北路招討使蕭圖玉奏伐甘州回鶻，破蕭州，盡俘其民。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Northwestern Pacification Commission commissioner Xiao Tuyu memorialized attacking Ganzhou Uyghur, broke Xiaozhou, captured all its people.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Northwestern Pacification commissioner Xiao Tuyu reported an attack on the Ganzhou Uyghur in which Xiaozhou was taken and its entire population captured.

sentences.zh: 詔修土隗口故城以實之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered repairing Turuikou old city to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the old city at Turuikou repaired and populated.

sentences.zh: 丙午，高麗西京留守康肇弒其主誦，擅立誦從兄詢，詔諸道繕甲兵，以備東征。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, Goryeo Western Capital military governor Kang Zhao assassinated his lord King Song, on his own authority installed Song's cousin King Xun; edict ordered various circuits to prepare armor and weapons, to prepare for eastern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Goryeo Western Capital governor Kang Zhao murdered King Song and installed Song's cousin King Xun without authorization; an edict ordered all circuits to ready arms for an eastern expedition.

sentences.zh: 秋八月戊申，振平州饑民。

translations.literal: In autumn, eighth month, on wushen day, relieved Ping Prefecture famine victims.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day in the eighth autumn month famine relief was distributed at Ping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，幸中京。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, favored visit to Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the court visited the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，謁顯、乾二陵。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, paid respects at Xian and Qian Mausoleums.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Emperor visited the Xian and Qian mausoleums.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，自將伐高麗，遣使報宋。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, personally led campaign against Goryeo, dispatched envoys to notify Song.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Emperor personally led a campaign against Goryeo and sent envoys to inform Song.

sentences.zh: 以皇弟楚國王隆祐留守京師，北府宰相、駙馬都尉蕭排押為都統，北面林牙僧奴為都監。

translations.literal: Made the Emperor's younger brother Prince of Chu Longyou remain to guard the capital, Northern Chancellery chancellor and imperial son-in-law Xiao Paia as supreme commander, Northern Privy Chancellor Sengnu as inspector general.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Chu Longyou was left to guard the capital; Northern Chancellery chancellor and imperial son-in-law Xiao Paia was made supreme commander, and Northern Privy Chancellor Sengnu inspector general.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，遣使冊西平王李德昭為夏國王。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on yiyou day, dispatched envoys to invest Western Peace King Li Dezhao as King of Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day of the ninth month envoys were sent to invest Western Peace King Li Dezhao as King of Xia.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，遣樞密直學士高正、引進使韓杞宣問高麗王詢。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, dispatched Privy Direct Academician Gao Zheng, Introducing Commissioner Han Qi to question Goryeo King Xun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Privy Direct Academician Gao Zheng and Introducing Commissioner Han Qi were dispatched to question Goryeo King Xun.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午朔，女直進良馬萬匹，乞從征高麗，許之。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on bingwu new moon, Jurchen presented ten thousand good horses, begged to follow campaign against Goryeo; permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu new moon of the tenth winter month the Jurchen presented ten thousand fine horses and asked to join the Goryeo campaign; permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 王詢遣使奉表乞罷師，不許。

translations.literal: King Xun dispatched envoys submitting a memorial begging withdrawal of army; not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: King Xun sent envoys begging the army be withdrawn; the request was refused.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，大軍渡鴨淥江，康肇拒戰，敗之，退保銅州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on yiyou day, the great army crossed the Yalu River; Kang Zhao resisted battle, was defeated, withdrew to defend Tong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day of the eleventh month the main army crossed the Yalu River; Kang Zhao offered battle, was defeated, and fell back to defend Tong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，肇復出，右皮室詳穩耶律敵魯擒肇及副將李立，追殺數十里，獲所棄糧餉、鎧仗。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Zhao again came out; Right Pishi xiangwen Yelü Dilu captured Zhao and vice general Li Li, pursued and killed for several tens of li, captured abandoned grain supplies and armor and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Kang Zhao sallied forth again; Right Pishi xiangwen Yelü Dilu captured him and vice general Li Li, pursued the enemy for several tens of li, and seized abandoned provisions, armor, and weapons.

sentences.zh: 戊子，銅、霍、貴、寧等州皆降。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Tong, Huo, Gui, Ning and other prefectures all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Tong, Huo, Gui, Ning, and other prefectures all surrendered.

sentences.zh: 排押至奴古達嶺，遇敵兵，戰敗之。

translations.literal: Paia reached Nuguda Ridge, encountered enemy troops, battled and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Paia reached Nuguda Ridge, met enemy forces, and defeated them in battle.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，王詢遣使上表請朝，許之。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, King Xun dispatched envoys submitting a memorial requesting audience; permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day King Xun sent envoys requesting an audience; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 禁軍士俘掠。

translations.literal: Forbade army soldiers captive plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers were forbidden to plunder captives.

sentences.zh: 以政事舍人馬保佑為開京留守，安州團練使王八為副留守。

translations.literal: Made Administrative Clerk Ma Baoyou Kaegyeong garrison commander, An Prefecture regiment trainer Wang Ba as vice garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: Administrative Clerk Ma Baoyou was made Kaegyeong garrison commander and An Prefecture regiment trainer Wang Ba vice garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 遣太子太師乙凜將騎兵一千，送保佑等赴京。

translations.literal: Dispatched Crown Prince Grand Tutor Yi Lin to lead one thousand cavalry, escort Baoyou and others to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Grand Tutor Yi Lin was sent with one thousand cavalry to escort Baoyou and the others to the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，守將卓思正殺遼使者韓喜孫等十人，領兵出拒，保佑等還。

translations.literal: On renchen day, garrison commander Zhuo Sizheng killed Liao envoys Han Xisun and ten others, led troops out to resist; Baoyou and others returned.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day garrison commander Zhuo Sizheng killed Liao envoys Han Xisun and ten others and led troops out to resist; Baoyou and the others withdrew.

sentences.zh: 遣乙凜領兵擊之，思正遂奔西京。

translations.literal: Dispatched Yi Lin to lead troops to attack him; Sizheng then fled to Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Lin was dispatched to attack him with troops; Sizheng then fled to the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 圍之，五日不克。

translations.literal: Besieged it, five days without taking it.
translations.idiomatic: The city was besieged for five days without being taken.

sentences.zh: 駐蹕城西。

translations.literal: Imperial halt west of the city.
translations.idiomatic: The court encamped west of the city.

sentences.zh: 高麗禮部郎中渤海陀失來降。

translations.literal: Goryeo Ministry of Rites middle-rank official Bohai Tuoshi came and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Bohai Tuoshi, a middle-rank official of Goryeo's Ministry of Rites, came over and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 庚子，遣排押、盆奴等攻開京，遇高麗兵，敗之。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, dispatched Paia, Penu and others to attack Kaegyeong, encountered Goryeo troops, defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Xiao Paia, Penu, and others were sent to attack Kaegyeong, met Goryeo troops, and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 王詢棄城遁去，遂焚開京，至清江，還。

translations.literal: King Xun abandoned the city and fled; then burned Kaegyeong, reached Qing River, returned.
translations.idiomatic: King Xun abandoned the city and fled; Kaegyeong was then burned, and the army reached Qing River before turning back.

sentences.zh: 二十九年春正月乙亥朔，班師，所降諸城復叛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, spring, first month, on yihai new moon, army withdrew; the surrendered cities all rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, on the yihai new moon of the first spring month the army withdrew; the cities that had surrendered all rebelled again.

sentences.zh: 至貴州南峻嶺谷，大雨連日，馬駝皆疲，甲仗多遺棄，霽乃得渡。

translations.literal: Reaching Gui Prefecture's Nanjun Ridge valley, heavy rain for many days, horses and camels all exhausted, armor and weapons mostly abandoned; after clearing weather then able to cross.
translations.idiomatic: At Nanjun Ridge valley south of Gui Prefecture it rained heavily for many days; horses and camels were exhausted and much armor and equipment was abandoned before the army could cross once the weather cleared.

sentences.zh: 己丑，次鴨淥江。

translations.literal: On jichou day, halted at Yalu River.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the army halted at the Yalu River.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，皇后及皇弟楚國王隆祐迎於來遠城。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, Empress and the Emperor's younger brother Prince of Chu Longyou welcomed at Laiyuan City.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the Empress and Prince of Chu Longyou welcomed the court at Laiyuan City.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔罷諸軍。

translations.literal: On renchen day, edict disbanded the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day an edict ordered all armies disbanded.

sentences.zh: 己亥，次東京。

translations.literal: On jihai day, halted at Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the court halted at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉，謁乾、顯二陵。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiyou day, visited Qian and Xian Mausoleums.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day of the second month the Emperor visited the Qian and Xian mausoleums.

sentences.zh: 戊午，所俘高麗人分置諸陵廟，餘賜內戚、大臣。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, captured Goryeo people were distributed and assigned to various mausoleum temples; the remainder granted to inner kin and great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day captured Goryeo people were assigned to the various mausoleum temples, and the remainder were granted to imperial in-laws and senior ministers.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，大丞相晉國王耶律隆運薨。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jimao day, Grand Chancellor King of Jin Yelü Longyun died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day of the third month Grand Chancellor King of Jin Yelü Longyun died.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，皇弟楚國王隆祐權知北院樞密使事，樞密直學士高正為北院樞密副使。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, the Emperor's younger brother Prince of Chu Longyou was provisional Northern Privy Commissioner, Privy Direct Academician Gao Zheng was Northern Privy Vice Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Prince of Chu Longyou was made provisional Northern Privy Commissioner and Privy Direct Academician Gao Zheng Northern Privy Vice Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，南京、平州水，振之。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, Nanjing and Ping Prefecture flood, relief given.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day flooding at Nanjing and Ping Prefecture was met with relief.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以北院大王耶律室魯為北院樞密使，封韓王，北院郎君耶律世良為北院大王，前三司使劉慎行參知政事兼知南院樞密使事。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Northern Chancellery Great King Yelü Shilu was made Northern Privy Commissioner and enfeoffed King of Han, Northern Chancellery langjun Yelü Shiliang was Northern Chancellery Great King, former Three Departments commissioner Liu Shenxing was Associate Administrative Affairs commissioner and concurrently Southern Privy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Northern Chancellery Great King Yelü Shilu was appointed Northern Privy Commissioner and enfeoffed King of Han; Northern Chancellery langjun Yelü Shiliang was made Northern Chancellery Great King; and former Three Departments commissioner Liu Shenxing was appointed associate administrative affairs commissioner and concurrent Southern Privy Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，清暑老古堝。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, summer coolness at Laogu Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month the court took the summer retreat at Laogu Marsh.

sentences.zh: 五月甲戌朔，詔已奏之事送所司附日曆。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jiaxu new moon, edict ordered already submitted matters sent to the relevant offices to be appended to the calendar.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu new moon of the fifth month an edict ordered matters already submitted to the relevant offices to be appended to the court calendar.

sentences.zh: 又詔帳族有罪，黥墨依諸部人例。

translations.literal: Also edict ordered tent clans with crimes, tattoo ink according to the various tribes' precedent.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also ordered that guilty members of tent clans be tattooed according to tribal precedent.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以劉慎行為南院樞密使，南府宰相邢抱質知南院樞密使事。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, made Liu Shenxing Southern Privy Commissioner, Southern Chancellery chancellor Xing Baozhi to know Southern Privy Commissioner affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Liu Shenxing was appointed Southern Privy Commissioner and Southern Chancellery chancellor Xing Baozhi was assigned to manage Southern Privy Commissioner affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，升蔚州、利州為觀察使。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengxu day, elevated Wei Prefecture and Li Prefecture to observation commission status.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day of the sixth month Wei Prefecture and Li Prefecture were elevated to observation commissions.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，韓王耶律室魯薨。

translations.literal: On yimao day, King of Han Yelü Shilu died.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day King of Han Yelü Shilu died.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以南院大王化哥為北院樞密使。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, made Southern Chancellery Great King Huage Northern Privy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Southern Chancellery Great King Huage was appointed Northern Privy Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔西北路招討使、駙馬都尉蕭圖玉安撫西鄙。

translations.literal: On dingji day, edict ordered Northwestern Pacification commissioner and imperial son-in-law Xiao Tuyu to pacify the western frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On dingji day an edict ordered Northwestern Pacification commissioner and imperial son-in-law Xiao Tuyu to pacify the western frontier.

sentences.zh: 置阻卜諸部節度使。

translations.literal: Established Zubu various tribes military commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Military commissioners were established for the various Zubu tribes.

sentences.zh: 是秋，獵於平地松林。

translations.literal: That autumn, hunted at Pingdi Songlin.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the court hunted at Pingdi Songlin.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚子朔，駐蹕廣平澱。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on gengzi new moon, imperial halt at Guangping Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi new moon of the tenth winter month the court encamped at Guangping Marsh.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，贈大丞相晉國王耶律隆運尚書令，謚文忠。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, posthumously granted Grand Chancellor King of Jin Yelü Longyun Palace Secretary, posthumous title Wenzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Grand Chancellor King of Jin Yelü Longyun was posthumously made Palace Secretary and given the posthumous title Wenzhong.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午朔，幸顯州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengwu new moon, favored visit to Xian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu new moon of the eleventh month the court visited Xian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子朔，復如廣平澱。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengzi new moon, again went to Guangping Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi new moon of the twelfth month the court again went to Guangping Marsh.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以知南院樞密使事邢抱質年老，詔乘小車入朝。

translations.literal: On guichou day, because Associate Southern Privy Commissioner Xing Baozhi was old in years, edict ordered riding small cart to attend court.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, because Xing Baozhi, who managed Southern Privy Commissioner affairs, was advanced in years, an edict allowed him to attend court in a small cart.

sentences.zh: 是月，置歸、寧二州。

translations.literal: That month, established Gui and Ning two prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: That month Gui and Ning Prefectures were established.

sentences.zh: 是年，禦試，放高承顏等二人及第。

translations.literal: That year, palace examination, released Gao Chengyan and two others passed and granted degree.
translations.idiomatic: That year Gao Chengyan and two others passed the palace examination.

sentences.zh: 開泰元年春正月己巳朔，宋遣趙湘、符成翰來賀。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaitai, spring, first month, on jisi new moon, Song dispatched Zhao Xiang, Fu Chenghan to come congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kaitai, on the jisi new moon of the first spring month Song sent Zhao Xiang and Fu Chenghan with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 癸未，長白山三十部女直酋長來貢，乞授爵秩。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, Changbai Mountain thirty divisions Jurchen chieftains came with tribute, begged granted ranks; granted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Jurchen chieftains of the thirty divisions of Changbai Mountain came with tribute and asked for ranks and titles; their request was granted.

sentences.zh: 甲申，駐蹕王子院。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, imperial halt at Prince's Courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the court encamped at Prince's Courtyard.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，望祠木葉山。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, paid respects at Muye Mountain from afar.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the court worshipped at Muye Mountain from afar.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，女直太保蒲撚等來朝。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Jurchen Grand Guardian Punian and others came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Jurchen Grand Guardian Punian and others came to court.

sentences.zh: 戊子，獵於買曷魯林。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, hunted at Maiheru Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the court hunted at Maiheru Forest.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，祠木葉山。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, sacrificed at Muye Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day sacrifice was performed at Muye Mountain.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，曷蘇館大王曷裏喜來朝。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Yisuguan Great King Yilixi came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Yisuguan Great King Yilixi came to court.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，駐蹕瑞鹿原。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renzi day, imperial halt at Ruilu Plain.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day of the second month the court encamped at Ruilu Plain.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，以蔚州為觀察，不隸武定軍。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiaxu day, made Wei Prefecture an observation commission, not subordinate to Wuding Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day of the third month Wei Prefecture was made an observation commission independent of the Wuding Army.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，如葦濼。

translations.literal: On yihai day, went to Wei Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the court went to Wei Marsh.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔封皇女八人為郡主。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, edict enfeoffed eight imperial daughters as commandery princesses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict enfeoffed eight imperial daughters as commandery princesses.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔卜日行拜山、大射柳之禮，命北宰相、駙馬、蘭陵郡王蕭寧，樞密使、司空邢抱質督有司具儀物。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, edict to select day soon to perform mountain worship and great willow-shooting rites, ordered Northern Chancellery chancellor and imperial son-in-law Prince of Lanling Xiao Ning, Privy Commissioner and Minister of Works Xing Baozhi to supervise the relevant offices in preparing ritual objects.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day an edict ordered a date chosen for the mountain-worship and great willow-shooting rites and directed Northern Chancellery chancellor and imperial son-in-law Prince of Lanling Xiao Ning and Privy Commissioner and Minister of Works Xing Baozhi to supervise the relevant offices in preparing the ritual equipment.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，皇弟楚國王隆祐徙封齊國王，留守東京。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, the Emperor's younger brother Prince of Chu Longyou was transferred enfeoffment to Prince of Qi, remaining to guard Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Prince of Chu Longyou was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Qi and left to guard the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，高麗遣蔡忠順來，乞稱臣如舊，詔王詢親朝。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on gengzi day, Goryeo dispatched Cai Zhongshun to come, begged to call self subject as before; edict ordered King Xun personally come to court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day of the fourth summer month Goryeo sent Cai Zhongshun asking to resume vassal status as before; an edict ordered King Xun to come to court in person.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，夏國遣使進良馬。

translations.literal: On renchen day, Xia State dispatched envoys presenting good horses.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Western Xia sent envoys presenting fine horses.

sentences.zh: 己酉，祀風伯。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, sacrificed to the Wind Lord.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day sacrifice was offered to the Wind Lord.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以前孟父房敞穩蕭佛奴為左夷離畢。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, made former Mengfu House Changwen Xiao Fonu Left yilibi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day former Mengfu House changwen Xiao Fonu was appointed Left yilibi.

sentences.zh: 五月戊辰朔，還上京。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on wuchen new moon, returned to Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen new moon of the fifth month the court returned to the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 詔裴玄感、邢祥知禮部貢舉，放進士史簡等十九人及第。

translations.literal: Edict ordered Pei Xuangan, Xing Xiang to supervise Ministry of Rites examinations, released jinshi Shi Jian and nineteen others passed and granted degree.
translations.idiomatic: An edict put Pei Xuangan and Xing Xiang in charge of the Ministry of Rites examinations; nineteen jinshi including Shi Jian passed and were granted degrees.

sentences.zh: 以駙馬蕭紹宗為鄭州防禦使。

translations.literal: Made imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaozong Zheng Prefecture defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaozong was appointed defense commissioner of Zheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以邢抱質為大同軍節度使。

translations.literal: On yihai day, made Xing Baozhi Datong Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Xing Baozhi was appointed military commissioner of the Datong Army.

sentences.zh: 六月，駐蹕上京。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, imperial halt at Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the court encamped at the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子，以耶律遂貞為遼興軍節度使，遂正北院宣徽使，張昭瑩南院宣徽使，耶律受益上京副留守，寇卿彰德軍節度使。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on bingzi day, made Yelü Suizhen Liaoxing Army military commissioner, Suizheng Northern Chancellery Xuanhui commissioner, Zhang Zhaoying Southern Chancellery Xuanhui commissioner, Yelü Shouyi Upper Capital vice garrison commander, Kou Qing Zhangde Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day of the seventh autumn month Yelü Suizhen was made military commissioner of the Liaoxing Army, Suizheng Northern Chancellery xuanhui commissioner, Zhang Zhaoying Southern Chancellery xuanhui commissioner, Yelü Shouyi Upper Capital vice garrison commander, and Kou Qing military commissioner of the Zhangde Army.

sentences.zh: 命耶律釋身奴、李操充賀宋國生辰信使副，蕭涅袞、齊泰賀宋正旦使副。

translations.literal: Ordered Yelü Shishennu, Li Cao as birthday congratulation envoys to Song, Xiao Niegun and Qi Tai as New Year's Day congratulation envoys to Song.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Shishennu and Li Cao were appointed birthday congratulation envoys to Song, and Xiao Niegun and Qi Tai New Year's Day congratulation envoys to Song.

sentences.zh: 進士康文昭、張素臣、郎玄達坐論知貢舉裴玄感、邢祥私曲，秘書省正字李萬上書，辭涉怨訕，皆杖而徒之，萬役陷河冶。

translations.literal: Jinshi Kang Wenzhao, Zhang Suchen, Lang Xuanda sat for discussing examination supervisor Pei Xuangan and Xing Xiang private partiality; Secretariat regular script compiler Li Wan submitted memorial, words involved resentment and slander; all were flogged and banished, Wan was conscripted to fall into River Ironworks.
translations.idiomatic: Jinshi Kang Wenzhao, Zhang Suchen, and Lang Xuanda were punished for criticizing examination supervisors Pei Xuangan and Xing Xiang for favoritism; Secretariat regular-script compiler Li Wan submitted a memorial whose language amounted to resentment and slander; all were flogged and banished, and Wan was conscripted to the River Ironworks.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申朔，鐵驪那沙等送兀惹百餘戶至賓州，賜絲絹。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on bingshen new moon, Iron Li Nasha and others sent more than one hundred Wurang households to Bin Prefecture, granted silk fabrics.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen new moon of the eighth month Iron Li Nasha and others sent more than one hundred Wurang households to Bin Prefecture and were granted silk fabrics.

sentences.zh: 是日，那沙乞賜佛像、儒書，詔賜《護國仁王佛像》一，《易》、《詩》、《書》、《春秋》、《禮記》各一部。

translations.literal: That day, Nasha begged granted Buddha image and Confucian books; edict granted Protect-the-Nation Benevolent-King Buddha Image one, Book of Changes, Classic of Poetry, Book of Documents, Spring and Autumn Annals, Record of Rites each one set.
translations.idiomatic: That day Nasha asked for a Buddha image and Confucian texts; an edict granted one Protect-the-Nation Benevolent-King Buddha Image and one set each of the Book of Changes, Classic of Poetry, Book of Documents, Spring and Autumn Annals, and Record of Rites.

sentences.zh: 己未，高麗王詢遣田拱之奉表，稱病不能朝，詔復取六州地。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Goryeo King Xun dispatched Tian Gongzhi submitting memorial, claimed illness unable to come to court; edict again took six prefectures' land.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Goryeo King Xun sent Tian Gongzhi with a memorial claiming illness and inability to come to court; an edict ordered the six prefectures' territory seized again.

sentences.zh: 是月，齊國王隆祐薨，輟朝五日。

translations.literal: That month, Prince of Qi Longyou died; court mourning halted five days.
translations.idiomatic: That month Prince of Qi Longyou died, and court was suspended for five days.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥，如中京。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on xinhai day the court went to the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day of the tenth winter month the court went to the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁卯，贈隆祐守太師，謚仁孝。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on dingmao day Longyou was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and given the posthumous title Renxiao.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day of the intercalary month Longyou was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and given the posthumous title Renxiao.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午朔，文武百官加上尊號曰弘文宣武尊道至德崇仁廣孝聰睿昭聖神贊天輔皇帝。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on the jiawu new moon, civil and military officials bestowed the honorific Hongwen Xuanwu Zundao Zhide Chongren Guangxiao Congrui Zhaosheng Shenzan Tianfu Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu new moon of the eleventh month civil and military officials bestowed on the Emperor the honorific Hongwen Xuanwu Zundao Zhide Chongren Guangxiao Congrui Zhaosheng Shenzan Tianfu Emperor.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元開泰。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed to Kaitai.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Kaitai.

sentences.zh: 改幽都府為析津府，薊北縣為析津縣，幽都縣為宛平縣，覃恩中外。

translations.literal: Youdu Prefecture was changed to Xijin Prefecture, Jibei County to Xijin County, Youdu County to Wanping County, and grace extended at home and abroad.
translations.idiomatic: Youdu Prefecture was renamed Xijin Prefecture, Jibei County was renamed Xijin County, Youdu County was renamed Wanping County, and grace was extended throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 己亥，賜夏國使、東頭供奉官曹文斌、呂文貴、竇珪祐、守榮、武元正等爵有差。

translations.literal: On jihai day the Western Xia envoys and Eastern Head Serving Official Cao Wenbin, Lü Wengui, Dou Guiyou, Shou Rong, Wu Yuanzheng, and others were granted ranks in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the Western Xia envoys and Eastern Head Serving Official Cao Wenbin, Lü Wengui, Dou Guiyou, Shou Rong, Wu Yuanzheng, and others were granted ranks in varying measure.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，前遼州錄事張庭美六世同居，儀坤州劉興胤四世同居，各給復三年。

translations.literal: On guimao day former Liaozhou clerk Zhang Tingmei had six generations living together, and Yikun Prefecture's Liu Xingyin had four generations living together; each was granted three years' tax exemption.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day former Liaozhou clerk Zhang Tingmei, who had six generations living together, and Yikun Prefecture's Liu Xingyin, who had four generations living together, were each granted three years' tax exemption.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，西北招討使蕭圖玉奏七部太師阿裏底因其部民之怨，殺本部節度使霸暗並屠其家以叛，阻卜執阿裏底以獻，而沿邊諸部皆叛。

translations.literal: On jiachen day Northwestern Road pacification commissioner Xiao Tuyu reported that Seven Tribes Grand Preceptor Alidi, because of his people's resentment, killed native military commissioner Ba An and slaughtered his family in rebellion; the Zubu captured Alidi and presented him, while frontier tribes all rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Northwestern Road pacification commissioner Xiao Tuyu reported that Seven Tribes Grand Preceptor Alidi, because of resentment among his people, had killed native military commissioner Ba An and slaughtered his family in rebellion; the Zubu captured Alidi and presented him, while frontier tribes all rebelled.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅，奉遷南京諸帝石像於中京觀德殿，景宗及宣獻皇后於上京五鸞殿。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on bingyin day stone statues of the emperors from Nanjing were ceremonially moved to Guande Hall at the Central Capital, and Emperor Jingzong and Empress Xuanxian to Wuluan Hall at the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day of the twelfth month stone statues of the emperors from Nanjing were ceremonially moved to Guande Hall at the Central Capital, and Emperor Jingzong and Empress Xuanxian to Wuluan Hall at the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 壬申，振奉聖州饑民。

translations.literal: On renshen day famine victims of Fengsheng Prefecture were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day famine victims of Fengsheng Prefecture were relieved.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，賜皇弟秦晉國王隆慶鐵券。

translations.literal: On gengchen day the Emperor's younger brother King of Qin-Jin Longqing was granted an iron tally of privilege.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the Emperor's younger brother King of Qin-Jin Longqing was granted an iron tally of privilege.

sentences.zh: 癸未，劉晨言殿中高可垣、中京留守推官李可舉治獄明允，詔超遷之。

translations.literal: On guiwei day Liu Chen reported that Palace attendant Gao Keyuan and Central Capital regent judicial assistant Li Keju handled cases fairly and clearly; an edict ordered their exceptional promotion.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Liu Chen reported that Palace attendant Gao Keyuan and Central Capital regent judicial assistant Li Keju handled cases fairly and clearly, and an edict ordered their exceptional promotion.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔諸道水災饑民質男女者，起來年正月，日計傭錢十文，價折傭盡，遣還其家。

translations.literal: On jiashen day an edict ordered that among famine victims in all circuits who had pawned sons and daughters due to floods, counting from the first month of the coming year they would pay ten cash per day in hired labor wages until the pawn price was worked off, then be sent home.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day an edict ordered that among flood victims in all circuits who had pawned sons and daughters, starting from the first month of the coming year they would pay ten cash per day in hired labor until the pawn price was worked off, then be sent home.

sentences.zh: 歸州言其居民本新羅所遷，未習文字，請設學以教之，詔允所請。

translations.literal: Guizhou reported that its inhabitants had originally been relocated from Silla and had not learned writing; they requested schools be established to teach them, and the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou reported that its inhabitants had originally been relocated from Silla and had not learned writing; they requested schools be established to teach them, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 貴德、龍化、儀坤、雙、遼、同、祖七州，至是有詔始征商。

translations.literal: Guide, Longhua, Yikun, Shuang, Liao, Tong, and Zu — seven prefectures — from this time received an edict beginning to levy commercial taxes.
translations.idiomatic: Guide, Longhua, Yikun, Shuang, Liao, Tong, and Zu — seven prefectures — from this time received an edict beginning to levy commercial taxes.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔諸鎮建宣敕樓。

translations.literal: On jichou day an edict ordered all garrison towns to build proclamation towers.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day an edict ordered all garrison towns to build proclamation towers.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月癸巳朔，以裴玄感為翰林承旨，邢祥給事中，石用中翰林學士，呂德推樞密直學士，張儉政事舍人，邢抱質加開府儀同三司、守司空兼侍中，王繼忠中京留守、檢校太師，戶部侍郎劉涇加工部尚書，駙馬蕭紹宗加檢校太師，耶律控溫加政事令，封幽王。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on the guisi new moon Pei Xuangan was made Hanlin Academician-in-Attendance, Xing Xiang made Supervising Secretary, Shi Yongzhong Hanlin Academician, Lü Detui Privy Council Academician, Zhang Jian Political Affairs Attendant, Xing Baozhi promoted to Acting Minister of Works with Extraordinary Honorific Equal to Three Councillors and Concurrent Palace Grand Secretary, Wang Jizhong made Central Capital regent and Acting Grand Preceptor, Vice Minister of Revenue Liu Jing promoted to Minister of Works, imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaozong promoted to Acting Grand Preceptor, and Yelü Kongwen promoted to Political Affairs Commissioner and enfeoffed as King of You.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the guisi new moon of the first spring month, Pei Xuangan was appointed Hanlin Academician-in-Attendance, Xing Xiang Supervising Secretary, Shi Yongzhong Hanlin Academician, Lü Detui Privy Council Academician, and Zhang Jian Political Affairs Attendant; Xing Baozhi was promoted to Acting Minister of Works with Extraordinary Honorific Equal to Three Councillors and Concurrent Palace Grand Secretary; Wang Jizhong was made Central Capital regent and Acting Grand Preceptor; Vice Minister of Revenue Liu Jing was promoted to Minister of Works; imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaozong was promoted to Acting Grand Preceptor; and Yelü Kongwen was promoted to Political Affairs Commissioner and enfeoffed as King of You.

sentences.zh: 丁未，如瑞鹿原。

translations.literal: On dingwei day the court went to Ruilu Plain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the court went to Ruilu Plain.

sentences.zh: 北院樞密使耶律化哥封豳王。

translations.literal: Northern Court Privy Council Commissioner Yelü Huage was enfeoffed as King of Bin.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Court Privy Council Commissioner Yelü Huage was enfeoffed as King of Bin.

sentences.zh: 以馬氏為麗儀，耿氏淑儀，尚寢白氏昭儀，尚服李氏順儀，尚功艾氏芳儀，尚書孫氏和儀。

translations.literal: The Ma clan was made Elegant Consort, the Geng clan Pure Consort, Palace Bed Attendant Bai Bright Consort, Palace Attire Attendant Li Gracious Consort, Palace Works Attendant Ai Fragrant Consort, and Palace Secretary Attendant Sun Harmonious Consort.
translations.idiomatic: The Ma clan was made Elegant Consort, the Geng clan Pure Consort, Palace Bed Attendant Bai Bright Consort, Palace Attire Attendant Li Gracious Consort, Palace Works Attendant Ai Fragrant Consort, and Palace Secretary Attendant Sun Harmonious Consort.

sentences.zh: 己未，錄囚。

translations.literal: On jiwei day prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 烏古、敵烈叛，右皮室詳穩延壽率兵討之。

translations.literal: The Wugu and Dilie rebelled; Right Pishi Xiaowen commander Yanshou led troops to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: The Wugu and Dilie rebelled, and Right Pishi Xiaowen commander Yanshou led troops to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 是月，達旦國兵圍鎮州，州軍堅守，尋引去。

translations.literal: That month Dadan state troops besieged Zhen Prefecture; the prefectural army held firm and they soon withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: That month Dadan state troops besieged Zhen Prefecture; the prefectural army held firm and the besiegers soon withdrew.

sentences.zh: 二月丙子，詔以麥務川為象雷縣，女河川為神水縣，羅家軍為閭山縣，山子川為富庶縣，習家砦為龍山縣，阿覽峪為勸農縣，松山川為松山縣，金甸子為金原縣。

translations.literal: Second month, on bingzi day an edict established Maiwu River as Xiangle County, Nühe River as Shenshui County, Luojia Army as Lüshan County, Shanzi River as Fushu County, Xijia Stockade as Longshan County, Alan Valley as Quannong County, Songshan River as Songshan County, and Jindianzi as Jinyuan County.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day of the second month an edict established Maiwu River as Xiangle County, Nühe River as Shenshui County, Luojia Army as Lüshan County, Shanzi River as Fushu County, Xijia Stockade as Longshan County, Alan Valley as Quannong County, Songshan River as Songshan County, and Jindianzi as Jinyuan County.

sentences.zh: 壬午，遣北院樞密副使高正按察諸道獄。

translations.literal: On renwu day Northern Court Privy Council Vice Commissioner Gao Zheng was dispatched to inspect prisons in all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Northern Court Privy Council Vice Commissioner Gao Zheng was sent to inspect prisons in all circuits.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰朔，化哥以西北路略平，留兵戍鎮州，赴行在。

translations.literal: Third month, on the renchen new moon, Huage because the Northwestern Route was largely pacified left troops to garrison Zhen Prefecture and went to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen new moon of the third month Huage, because the Northwestern Route was largely pacified, left troops to garrison Zhen Prefecture and went to the mobile court.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，拜日。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiazi day the sun was worshipped.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day of the fourth summer month the court worshipped the sun.

sentences.zh: 詔從上京請，以韓斌所括贍國、撻魯河、奉、豪等州戶二萬五千四百有奇，置長霸、興仁、保和等十縣。

translations.literal: An edict granted the Upper Capital's request to register 25,400-plus households from Shanyu, Talu River, Feng, Hao, and other prefectures surveyed by Han Bin, establishing ten counties including Changba, Xingren, and Baohe.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted the Upper Capital's request to register more than 25,400 households from Shanyu, Talu River, Feng, Hao, and other prefectures surveyed by Han Bin, establishing ten counties including Changba, Xingren, and Baohe.

sentences.zh: 丙子，如緬山。

translations.literal: On bingzi day the court went to Mianshan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the court went to Mianshan.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯朔，復命化哥等西討。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on the xinmao new moon, Huage and others were again ordered on a western campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao new moon of the fifth month Huage and others were again ordered on a western campaign.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉朔，遣中丞耶律資忠使高麗，取六州舊地。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on the xinyou new moon, Censor Yelü Zizhong was dispatched as envoy to Goryeo to recover the six old prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou new moon of the sixth month Censor Yelü Zizhong was sent as envoy to Goryeo to recover the six old prefectures.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，烏古、敵烈皆復故疆。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on renchen day the Wugu and Dilie all recovered their former territories.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day of the seventh autumn month the Wugu and Dilie all recovered their former territories.

sentences.zh: 乙未，西南招討使、政事令斜軫奏党項諸部叛者皆遁黃河北模赧山，其不叛者曷黨、烏迷兩部因據其地，今復西遷，詰之則曰逐水草，不早圖之，後恐為患。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Southwestern Road pacification commissioner and Political Affairs Commissioner Xiezhen reported that rebel Tangut tribes had all fled north of the Yellow River to Mo'nanshan; non-rebel Hedang and Wumi tribes had occupied their lands and now had moved west again; when questioned they said they were following pasture and water, and if not dealt with early they might become a later menace.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Southwestern Road pacification commissioner and Political Affairs Commissioner Xiezhen reported that rebel Tangut tribes had all fled north of the Yellow River to Mo'nanshan; the non-rebel Hedang and Wumi tribes had occupied their lands and now had moved west again; when questioned they said they were following pasture and water, and if not dealt with early they might become a later menace.

sentences.zh: 又聞前後叛者多投西夏，西夏不納。

translations.literal: It was also heard that many rebels before and after had fled to Western Xia, which did not accept them.
translations.idiomatic: It was also heard that many rebels before and after had fled to Western Xia, which did not accept them.

sentences.zh: 詔遣使再問西遷之意，若歸故地，則可就加撫諭。

translations.literal: An edict ordered envoys sent again to ask their intent in moving west; if they returned to their former lands, they could then be reassured and pacified on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered envoys sent again to ask their intent in moving west; if they returned to their former lands, they could then be reassured and pacified on the spot.

sentences.zh: 使不報，上怒，欲伐之。

translations.literal: The envoys brought no reply; the Emperor was angered and wished to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys brought no reply; the Emperor was angered and wished to attack them.

sentences.zh: 遂詔李德昭：「今党項叛，我欲西伐，爾當東擊，毋失掎角之勢。

translations.literal: Then an edict was sent to Li Dezhao: "Now the Tangut have rebelled; I wish to campaign west. You should strike east and not lose the pincer advantage.

translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the court hunted on the Huang River banks.

translations.idiomatic: On wushen day transport commissioners were established in Nanjing, Fengsheng, Ping, Yu, Yun, Ying, Shuo, and other prefectures.

translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon of the fifth month the court went to Mianshan for the summer retreat.

translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the Emperor's nephew Hudugu was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangping Commandery.

translations.idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the second month the court went to Sadi Marsh.

translations.idiomatic: On guichou day of the fourth summer month Linqiya Jianfu was made Northern Court Great King.

translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Xiao Dilie and others returned from the campaign against Goryeo.

translations.idiomatic: Privy Council Commissioner Guanning reported a great defeat of the eight tribes of Dilie; an edict ordered attendant Sala to convey commendation, performing the hand-clasp ceremony in his place.

translations.idiomatic: Shiliang pursued the Dilie De as far as Qingni Gorge.

translations.literal: At the time the Yujue had already been pacified; the court discussed inward relocation of their people, but the Yujue, attached to their native soil and unwilling to move, then rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: The Yujue had just been pacified when the court proposed resettling them inland, but they clung to their homeland and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 世良懲創，既破迪烈得，輒殲其丁壯。

translations.literal: Shiliang as punishment, having defeated the Dilie De, immediately exterminated their able-bodied men.
translations.idiomatic: As punishment Shiliang, once he had broken the Dilie De, slaughtered their adult males.

translations.literal: He drove the army across the Hela River to attack remnant bands; scouts were careless, and his general Bokuo gathered troops in dense forest and struck the Liao army unprepared.
translations.idiomatic: He led his troops across the Hela River to pursue the remnants, but careless scouting let the rebel general Bokuo mass men in thick woods and fall on the Liao army unawares.

translations.literal: The Liao army retreated slightly and formed battle lines on the river bend.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao army fell back a short distance and formed ranks on the river bend.

translations.idiomatic: That night Bokuo launched a night attack.

translations.idiomatic: The next day Liao reinforcements arrived; Bokuo had incited the Yujue to scatter, and Shiliang pursued them into dangerous country.

translations.literal: Bokuo had just blocked the pass and rested briefly; the Liao army scouts learned his location, but Shiliang did not promptly strike; Bokuo escaped on light horses.
translations.idiomatic: Bokuo had halted in a defile to rest; scouts found him, but Shiliang failed to strike quickly and Bokuo fled on fast horses.

sentences.zh: 獲其輜重及所誘於厥之眾，並遷迪烈得所獲轄麥裏部民，城臚朐河上以居之。

translations.literal: They captured his baggage train and the Yujue people he had induced, and also moved the Xiabaili division people captured from the Dilie De, fortifying a city on the Luch River to settle them.
translations.idiomatic: They took his baggage train and the Yujue he had won over, resettled the Xiabaili people captured from the Dilie De, and built a town on the Luch River for them.

translations.idiomatic: That month Xiao Yangge married the Princess of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，命北府宰相劉晟為都統，樞密使耶律世良為副，殿前都點檢蕭屈烈為都監以伐高麗。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on xinsi day, ordered Northern Chancellery chancellor Liu Sheng as commander-in-chief, Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelü Shiliang as deputy, and Palace Front inspector Xiao Qulie as supervisory commander to campaign against Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day of the fifth month Liu Sheng was appointed commander-in-chief, Yelü Shiliang deputy commander, and Xiao Qulie supervisory commander for a campaign against Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 晟先攜家置邊郡，致緩師期，追還之。

translations.literal: Sheng had first moved his family to a border prefecture, causing delay in the army schedule; he was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng had moved his household to a frontier prefecture, delaying the campaign, and was recalled.

sentences.zh: 以世良、屈烈總兵進討。

translations.literal: Shiliang and Qulie were put in charge of the army to advance in attack.
translations.idiomatic: Shiliang and Qulie were given overall command and marched to attack.

sentences.zh: 以耶律德政為遼興軍節度使，蕭年骨烈天成軍節度使。

translations.literal: Yelü Dezheng was made military commissioner of Liaoxing Army, and Xiao Nianguli military commissioner of Tiancheng Army.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Dezheng was appointed military commissioner of the Liaoxing Army and Xiao Nianguli military commissioner of the Tiancheng Army.

sentences.zh: 李仲舉卒，詔賻恤其家。

translations.literal: Li Zhongju died; an edict granted funeral payment and consolation to his family.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhongju died, and an edict ordered funeral gifts and relief for his family.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，上拜日如禮。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on gengxu day, the Emperor worshipped the sun according to rite.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day of the sixth month the Emperor performed the sun-worship rite.

sentences.zh: 以麻都骨世勛，易衣馬為好。

translations.literal: Exchanging robes and horses with Madugu of Shixiong as tokens of friendship.
translations.idiomatic: Robes and horses were exchanged with Madugu of Shixiong as a bond of friendship.

sentences.zh: 以上京留守耶律八哥為北院樞密副使。

translations.literal: Upper Capital regent Yelü Bage was made Northern Court deputy commissioner of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Upper Capital regent Yelü Bage was appointed deputy commissioner of the Northern Court Military Affairs Commission.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，上又拜日，遂幸秋山。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, the Emperor again worshipped the sun, then favored and visited Autumn Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the Emperor again performed the sun-worship rite, then went to Autumn Mountain.

sentences.zh: 自八月射鹿至於九月，復自癸丑至於辛酉，連獵於有柏、碎石、太保、響應、松山諸山。

translations.literal: From eighth month deer-shooting until ninth month, again from guichou to xinyou, continuous hunting at Youbai, Suishi, Taibao, Xiangying, Song Mountain and other mountains.
translations.idiomatic: From the eighth month through the ninth the court hunted deer, and from guichou to xinyou hunted continuously on Mount Youbai, Suishi, Taibao, Xiangying, Song Mountain, and others.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，與夷離畢、兵部尚書蕭榮寧定為交契，以重君臣之好。

translations.literal: On dingmao day made a pact of friendship with yilibi and Minister of War Xiao Rongning to strengthen the bond between ruler and minister.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Emperor entered a pact of friendship with yilibi and Minister of War Xiao Rongning to deepen the bond between ruler and minister.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以旗鼓拽剌詳穩題裏姑為六部奚王。

translations.literal: On bingzi day made qigu drala xianwen Tiligu king of the Six Xi Divisions.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Tiligu, qigu drala xianwen, was appointed king of the Six Xi Divisions.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，駐蹕撻剌割濼。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, imperial halt at Talage Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month the court encamped at Talage Marsh.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申，詔汰東京僧，及命上京、中京洎諸宮選精兵五萬五千人以備東征。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on gengshen day, an edict purged Eastern Capital monks, and ordered the Upper Capital, Central Capital, and the various palaces to select fifty-five thousand elite troops in preparation for eastern expedition.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day of the eleventh month an edict culled Buddhist monks in the Eastern Capital and ordered the Upper Capital, Central Capital, and the palace households to furnish fifty-five thousand elite troops for the eastern campaign.

sentences.zh: 十二月，南巡海僥。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, southern tour to Haiqiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the court made a southern tour to Haiqiao.

sentences.zh: 還，幸顯州。

translations.literal: Returning, favored and visited Xian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the return the court visited Xian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月丁未，北幸。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, on dingwei day, northern tour.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on dingwei day of the first spring month, the court made a northern tour.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，耶律世良、蕭屈烈與高麗戰於郭州西，破之，斬首數萬級，盡獲其輜重。

translations.literal: On gengxu day Yelü Shiliang and Xiao Qulie fought Goryeo west of Guo Prefecture, defeated them, beheaded tens of thousands, and captured all their baggage.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Yelü Shiliang and Xiao Qulie fought Goryeo west of Guo Prefecture, broke them, took tens of thousands of heads, and seized all their baggage.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，師次南海軍，耶律世良薨於軍。

translations.literal: On yimao day the army halted at Nanhai Army; Yelü Shiliang died in camp.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the army reached Nanhai Army and Yelü Shiliang died in camp.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，駐蹕雪林。

translations.literal: On guiyou day imperial halt at Xuelin.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the court encamped at Xuelin.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，阻卜長來朝。

translations.literal: Second month, on jimao day, a Zubu chieftain came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day of the second month a Zubu chieftain came to court.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，如薩堤濼。

translations.literal: On xinsi day went to Sadai Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the court went to Sadai Marsh.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以前東京統軍使耶律韓留為右夷離畢。

translations.literal: On gengyin day former Eastern Capital army commander Yelü Hanliu was made right yilibi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day former Eastern Capital army commander Yelü Hanliu was appointed right yilibi.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，皇子宗真生。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Prince Zongzhen was born.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Prince Zongzhen was born.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，鼻骨德長撒保特、賽剌等來貢。

translations.literal: Third month, on yimao day, Bigude chieftains Sabote, Saila, and others came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day of the third month Bigude chieftains Sabote, Saila, and others came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，諸道獄空，詔進階賜物。

translations.literal: On xinyou day prisons in all circuits were empty; an edict granted promotion in rank and gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the prisons in every circuit stood empty, and an edict ordered promotions and gifts.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以前北院大王耶律敬溫為阿紥割只。

translations.literal: On bingyin day former Northern Court great king Yelü Jingwen was made azha gezhi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day former Northern Court great king Yelü Jingwen was appointed azha gezhi.

sentences.zh: 辛未，党項魁可來降。

translations.literal: On xinwei day Tangut chief Kuikke came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Tangut chief Kuikke submitted.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙亥，振招州民。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on yihai day, relief was given to the people of Zhao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day of the fourth summer month relief was given to the people of Zhao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以左夷離畢蕭合卓為北院樞密使，曷魯寧為副使。

translations.literal: On wuyin day left yilibi Xiao Hezhuo was made Northern Court commissioner of military affairs, and Heluning deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day left yilibi Xiao Hezhuo was appointed Northern Court commissioner of military affairs, with Heluning as deputy.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，清暑孤樹澱。

translations.literal: On gengchen day summer coolness at Gushu Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the court took the summer retreat at Gushu Marsh.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，尚書蕭姬隱坐出使後期，削其官。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jiazi day, Minister Xiao Jiyin because of returning late from a mission had his office stripped.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day of the fifth month Minister Xiao Jiyin was dismissed for returning late from an envoy mission.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以耿元吉為戶部使。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Geng Yuanji was made Commissioner of the Household.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Geng Yuanji was appointed commissioner of the household bureau.

sentences.zh: 六月，以政事舍人吳克昌按察霸州刑獄。

translations.literal: Sixth month, administrative secretary Wu Kechang was sent to inspect legal cases at Ba Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month administrative secretary Wu Kechang was sent to review criminal cases in Ba Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，回鶻獻孔雀。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the Uyghur presented a peacock.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Uyghur presented a peacock.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，獵於赤山。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiachen day, hunted at Red Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Red Mountain.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，幸懷州，有事於諸陵。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on bingzi day, favored and visited Huai Prefecture, performed rites at the various mausoleums.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day of the eighth month the court visited Huai Prefecture and offered rites at the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，還上京。

translations.literal: On wuyin day returned to the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the court returned to the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，皇弟南京留守秦晉國王隆慶來朝，上親出迎勞，至實德山，因同獵於松山。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on guimao day, the Emperor's younger brother Nanjing regent Qin-Jin State King Longqing came to court; the Emperor personally went out to welcome and comfort him; reaching Shide Mountain, they then hunted together at Song Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day of the ninth month the Emperor's younger brother, Nanjing regent and Qin-Jin State King Longqing, came to court; the Emperor went out in person to welcome him, and at Mount Shide they hunted together on Song Mountain.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，駐蹕杏堝。

translations.literal: On yichou day imperial halt at Xing Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day the court encamped at Xing Pass.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲午，封秦晉國王隆慶長子查割中山郡王，次子遂哥樂安郡王。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiawu day, enfeoffed Qin-Jin State King Longqing's eldest son Zhage as Prince of Zhongshan Commandery and second son Suige as Prince of Le'an Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day of the tenth winter month Longqing's eldest son Zhage was made Prince of Zhongshan and his second son Suige Prince of Le'an.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑朔，以參知政事馬保忠同知樞密院事、監修國史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on xinchou new moon, made associate state counselor Ma Baozhong concurrent commissioner of military affairs and director of state history compilation.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou new moon of the eleventh month associate state counselor Ma Baozhong was made concurrent commissioner of military affairs and director of the state history.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以北面林牙蕭隈窪為國舅詳隱。

translations.literal: On dingsi day made Northern Court linya Xiao Weiwo imperial maternal uncle xianyin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Northern Court linya Xiao Weiwo was appointed imperial maternal uncle xianyin.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，秦晉國王隆慶還，至北安薨，訃聞，上為哀慟，輟朝七日。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on yiyou day, Qin-Jin State King Longqing returning died at Bei'an; when the death report arrived the Emperor grieved deeply and suspended court for seven days.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day of the twelfth month Qin-Jin State King Longqing died at Bei'an on his way back; when word reached the court the Emperor was stricken with grief and suspended audience for seven days.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，宋遣張遜、王承德來賀千齡節。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Song dispatched Zhang Xun and Wang Chengde to come congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Song sent Zhang Xun and Wang Chengde to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

sentences.zh: 是歲，放進士孫傑等四十八人及第。

translations.literal: That year jinshi Sun Jie and forty-seven others were passed and granted degree.
translations.idiomatic: That year Sun Jie and forty-seven others passed the examinations.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月癸卯，如錐子河。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, on guimao day, went to Zhuizi River.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on guimao day of the first spring month, the court went to the Zhuizi River.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，以公主賽哥殺無罪婢，駙馬蕭圖玉不能齊家，降公主為縣主，削圖玉同平章事。

translations.literal: Second month, on jiaxu day, because Princess Saige killed an innocent maidservant and imperial son-in-law Xiao Tuyu could not manage the household, the Princess was demoted to county mistress and Tuyu's position as co-equal chief councillor was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day of the second month Princess Saige was demoted to county mistress and Xiao Tuyu was stripped of his co-equal chief councillor title because she had killed an innocent maidservant and he could not keep his household in order.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔國舅帳詳穩蕭隗窪將本部兵東征高麗，其國舅司事以都監攝之。

translations.literal: On dingchou day an edict ordered imperial maternal uncle tent xianwen Xiao Aiwo to lead his division's troops on eastern expedition against Goryeo; the imperial maternal uncle office affairs would be administered by the supervisory commander in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict ordered imperial maternal uncle xianwen Xiao Aiwo to lead his command east against Goryeo, with the supervisory commander acting in his office during the campaign.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以南面林牙涅合為南院大王。

translations.literal: On gengchen day made Southern Court linya Niehe Southern Court great king.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Southern Court linya Niehe was appointed Southern Court great king.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，如顯州，葬秦晉國王隆慶。

translations.literal: Third month, on yisi day, went to Xian Prefecture and buried Qin-Jin State King Longqing.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day of the third month the court went to Xian Prefecture and buried Qin-Jin State King Longqing.

sentences.zh: 有事於顯、乾二陵。

translations.literal: Performed rites at the Xian and Qian mausoleums.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice was offered at the Xian and Qian mausoleums.

sentences.zh: 追冊隆慶為太弟。

translations.literal: Posthumously enregistered Longqing as Imperial Elder Brother.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing was posthumously enregistered as Imperial Elder Brother.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，封隆慶少子謝家奴為長沙郡王，以樞密使漆水郡王耶律制心權知諸行宮都部署事。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinmao day, enfeoffed Longqing's youngest son Xiejianu as Prince of Changsha Commandery; Commissioner of Military Affairs Prince of Qishui Yelü Zhixin was put in temporary charge of all traveling palace deployments.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day of the fourth summer month Longqing's youngest son Xiejianu was made Prince of Changsha, and Commissioner of Military Affairs Prince of Qishui Yelü Zhixin was appointed acting director of all traveling palace deployments.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，禁命婦再醮。

translations.literal: On renchen day forbade widowed women remarriage.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day an edict forbade widows from remarrying.

sentences.zh: 丙申，如涼陘。

translations.literal: On bingshen day went to Liang Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the court went to Liang Pass.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌朔，命樞密使蕭合卓為都統，漢人行宮都部署王繼忠為副，殿前都點檢蕭屈烈為都監，以伐高麗。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on wuxu new moon, ordered Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiao Hezhuo as commander-in-chief, Han traveling palace deployment director Wang Jizhong as deputy, Palace Front inspector Xiao Qulie as supervisory commander to campaign against Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu new moon of the fifth month Xiao Hezhuo was appointed commander-in-chief, Wang Jizhong deputy commander, and Xiao Qulie supervisory commander for a campaign against Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 翌日，賜合卓劍，俾得專殺。

translations.literal: Next day granted Hezhuo a sword, enabling him to execute on his own authority.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Hezhuo was given a sword conferring authority to execute at his discretion.

sentences.zh: 丙午，錄囚。

translations.literal: On bingwu day reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 己酉，設四帳都詳穩。

translations.literal: On jiyou day established four-accounts chief xianwen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day chief xianwen posts were established for the four accounts.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以南京統軍使蕭惠為右夷離畢。

translations.literal: On jiayin day made Nanjing army commander Xiao Hui right yilibi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Nanjing army commander Xiao Hui was appointed right yilibi.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，祠木葉山、潢河。

translations.literal: On yimao day sacrificed at Muye Mountain and Huang River.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day sacrifice was offered at Muye Mountain and on the Huang River.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，駐蹕九層臺。

translations.literal: On yichou day imperial halt at Nine-Tier Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day the court encamped at the Nine-Tier Terrace.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰朔，德妃蕭氏賜死，葬兔兒山西。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on wuchen new moon, Noble Consort Xiao was granted death and buried west of Rabbit Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen new moon of the sixth month Noble Consort Xiao was ordered to take her own life and was buried west of Rabbit Mountain.

sentences.zh: 後數日，大風起冢上，晝暝，大雷電而雨不止者逾月。

translations.literal: Several days later great wind rose over the tomb, daylight darkened, great thunder and lightning and rain did not cease for more than a month.
translations.idiomatic: Several days later a great wind rose over the tomb, daylight turned dark, and thunder, lightning, and unceasing rain lasted more than a month.

sentences.zh: 是月，南京諸縣蝗。

translations.literal: That month Nanjing various counties had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That month locusts afflicted the counties of Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，如秋山。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinhai day, went to Autumn Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day of the seventh autumn month the court went to Autumn Mountain.

sentences.zh: 遣禮部尚書劉京、翰林學士吳叔達、知制誥仇正己、起居舍人程翥、吏部員外郎南承顏、禮部員外郎王景運分路按察刑獄。

translations.literal: Dispatched Minister of Rites Liu Jing, Hanlin academician Wu Shuda, drafter of edicts Qiu Zhengji, diarist Cheng Zhu, Ministry of Personnel vice bureau director Nan Chengyan, and Ministry of Rites vice bureau director Wang Jingyun to inspect legal cases by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jing, Wu Shuda, Qiu Zhengji, Cheng Zhu, Nan Chengyan, and Wang Jingyun were sent along separate routes to review criminal cases.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以西南路招討請，置寧仁縣於勝州。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, at the request of the Southwestern Pacification commissioner, established Ningren County at Sheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, at the Southwestern Pacification Commissioner's request, Ningren County was established in Sheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子，還上京，以皇子屬思生，大赦。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on gengzi day returned to Upper Capital; because Prince Shusi was born, general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day of the ninth month the court returned to the Upper Capital and proclaimed a general amnesty on the birth of Prince Shusi.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以駙馬蕭璉、節度使化哥、知制誥仇正己、楊佶充賀宋生辰正旦使副。

translations.literal: On dingwei day made imperial son-in-law Xiao Lian, military commissioner Huage, drafter of edicts Qiu Zhengji, and Yang Ji envoys and deputies to congratulate Song on birthday and New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Xiao Lian, Huage, Qiu Zhengji, and Yang Ji were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on the Emperor's birthday and New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，蕭合卓等攻高麗興化軍不克，還師。

translations.literal: On yimao day Xiao Hezhuo and others attacked Goryeo's Xinghua Army but did not take it and returned the army.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Xiao Hezhuo and others failed to take Goryeo's Xinghua Army and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯，南京路饑，免雲、應、朔、弘等州粟振之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingmao day, Nanjing circuit had famine; exempted grain and gave relief in Yun, Ying, Shuo, Hong and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day of the tenth winter month famine struck the Nanjing circuit, and grain levies were remitted and relief distributed in Yun, Ying, Shuo, Hong, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 辛未，獵鏵子河。

translations.literal: On xinwei day hunted at Huazi River.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the court hunted on the Huazi River.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，駐蹕達離山。

translations.literal: On gengyin day imperial halt at Dali Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the court encamped at Mount Dali.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯，建州節度使石匡弼卒。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on yimao day, Jian Prefecture military commissioner Shi Kuangbi died.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day of the eleventh month Jian Prefecture military commissioner Shi Kuangbi died.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，上輕騎還上京。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on dingmao day the Emperor returned to the Upper Capital on light horses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day of the twelfth month the Emperor rode back to the Upper Capital with a light escort.

sentences.zh: 戊子，宋遣李行簡、張信來賀千齡節。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Song dispatched Li Xingjian and Zhang Xin to come congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Song sent Li Xingjian and Zhang Xin to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

sentences.zh: 翌日，宋馮元、張綸來賀正旦。

translations.literal: Next day Song Feng Yuan and Zhang Lun came to congratulate New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Song sent Feng Yuan and Zhang Lun to congratulate New Year's Day.
